name: Insert Content
author: Joseph Adediji

sections.description:
Insert Content is a lightweight WordPress plugin that allows you to easily add custom text, code, or HTML to the beginning and end of your blog posts or WordPress pages.

This is a lightweight no distraction plugin for adding various text or code to the beginning or end of your posts or pages.
It is useful to people who don’t want to edit theme files to manually insert codes,text,html in the described locations.

Key Features:

  • Add HTML, Text or any code to the beginning of post on single post pages.
  • Add HTML, Text or any code to the end of post on single post pages.
  • Add HTML, Text or any code to the beginning of WordPress pages.
  • Add HTML, Text or any code to the end of WordPress pages.
  • Simple and minimalistic settings page.

Supported WordPress version

It is compatible from 3.8 to 6.7 WordPress version.
sections.installation:
• Download the plugin
  • Unzip the archive and upload the folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  • Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  • Go to ‘Insert Content’ in the settings menu
  • Add your custom Code,Text,HTML in the desired texboxes or keep empty to disable (both optional) and click Update

short_description: A simple plugin to insert Custom Code,Text or HTML before and After Content Text of Single Posts or Pages.
